subject: Re: On-prem / Air-gapped Deployment — Follow-up & hardware questions
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Foster <alex.foster@legacybank.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jun 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: on-prem / air-gapped deployment (recap + next steps)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a proposed list of next steps so we can align the technical path for an air-gapped on-prem deployment: 

Summary of what we heard:
- Legacy Bank requires a fully private, air-gapped deployment (no outbound egress to public internet) for regulatory and audit reasons.
- Primary workload: customer-facing document processing + redaction pipeline; latency target ~ <= 300ms p50 but peaks acceptable for batch jobs.
- Initial pilot scope: ~100 req/s sustained, spikes to ~200 req/s; concurrency target ~20.

Open/technical items we need to confirm from your side:
1) Peak/steady-state TPS and typical token lengths per request (helps sizing GPU pool and KV cache).
2) Hardware ownership preference (do you prefer Redwood-supplied racks or customer-owned servers?).
3) Upgrade/patch model in an air-gapped environment — do you require signed, offline bundles and on-site technicians for upgrades?
4) OS/kernel/driver change policy (will customer ops allow us to apply driver updates during P0 windows?).
5) HSM/KMS integration constraints for keys — any vendor or FIPS requirements?
6) On-site install window and physical access constraints (badge escort, maintenance windows).

Attachments: rfi-security-checklist.pdf (initial), onprem-hardware-inventory.xlsx (blank BOM template) — please fill and return when convenient.

Proposed next steps:
- Schedule a technical deep-dive with your infra/security + our SE/infra: Dev Patel and Ethan Park (30–60m).
- Fill the BOM template with existing rack/network details so we can propose a BOM.
- Confirm preferred upgrade/maintenance process (offline bundle vs remote pull).

I can make time Thursday or Friday (PST). Suggested slots: Thu 6/30 09:00–11:00 PT or Fri 7/1 13:00–15:00 PT. Let me know what works.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Alex Foster <alex.foster@legacybank.com>

Subject: Re: Follow-up: on-prem / air-gapped deployment (recap + next steps)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few answers and follow-ups from our side:

Answers to your questions:
1) Throughput/token sizes: target 100 req/s steady, spikes up to 150–200 req/s. Typical request ~ 400–600 tokens; some long docs hit ~1,200–1,500 tokens.
2) Hardware ownership: We prefer customer-owned hardware managed by our ops team. Procurement will handle ordering, but we need a validated BOM from Redwood (preferred part numbers).
3) Upgrades: We require offline, signed bundles for any binary/OS/driver changes. Remote outbound connections are restricted; we can provision an air-gapped USB transfer or an internal artifact repository reachable from the secured network.
4) Kernel/driver updates: Allowed but only in scheduled maintenance windows and after prior testing on a staging rack.
5) KMS/HSM: We use Thales HSM (FIPS 140-2) and expect any KMS integration to support customer on-prem HSM without key export.
6) On-site install: We have strict escort policies; on-site vendor engineers need name/ID pre-approval.

I've attached a preliminary inventory (onprem-hardware-inventory.xlsx) — it's a first pass.

Questions for Redwood:
- What GPU types do you certify/support for the air-gapped private package? (H100 vs A100?)
- How does Redwood handle offline attestations and signing of upgrade bundles?
- Can Redwood provide an example upgrade checklist and rollback steps for a kernel/driver patch?

We can do a technical deep-dive Thursday 6/30 at 12:00 PM ET (which is 09:00 PT) — Dev and Ethan are good to join.

Thanks,
Alex Foster
CTO, Legacy Bank
alex.foster@legacybank.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Foster <alex.foster@legacybank.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jun 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: on-prem / air-gapped deployment (recap + next steps)

Alex — great, thanks for the detail and the inventory. Short answers and next steps below; we'll cover the rest on the call Thursday.

GPU support/rec: Redwood supports both NVIDIA A100 and H100 in our private/on-prem package. Recommendation: H100 gives better throughput for long-context workloads and model variants we typically recommend for document-heavy pipelines; A100 is fully supported if that aligns better with your procurement. We'll include validated part numbers for both in the BOM.

Offline upgrades/attestations:
- We provide signed upgrade bundles (SHA256 + Redwood signature).
- Delivery options: hardware USB handoff, customer internal artifact repo, or a physically-supplied package.
- Installer runs fully offline and verifies signatures against a provided Redwood public key; no outbound connections required.
- Rollback: each upgrade creates a local snapshot; we ship a documented rollback procedure and a dry-run checklist.

KMS/HSM:
- We can integrate with Thales HSM via our on-prem KMS connector; keys do not leave the HSM. We will provide an integration guide and an engineering contact to validate the flow.

On-site logistics: Redwood SEs can be on-site for initial install if preferred; otherwise our runbook supports remote install via customer ops. We'll provide SE CVs and passport/ID details for pre-approval.

Action items (who / by when):
- Marissa (Redwood): Share validated BOM + part numbers for A100/H100 by EOD Wed (2026-06-30).
- Dev (Redwood SE): Deep-dive and upgrade demo on Thu 2026-06-30 09:00 PT (confirmed).
- Alex (Legacy): Fill any missing fields in the onprem-hardware-inventory.xlsx and share network segmentation diagram before the call if possible.

Call invite: I sent a calendar invite for Thu 6/30 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET with Dev and Ethan on the bridge. Link to HubSpot deal and shared BOM in the invite notes.

Attaching: rfi-security-checklist.pdf (updated), and I will attach the validated BOM after internal review.

Marissa
